## File: facebookresearch_digit360/digit360/ros2/d360/d360/examples/d360_image_decode.py

Prompts

```
['run the ROS2 node that decodes H.264 encoded images from multiple d360 sensors', 'create an ImageDecoder instance that subscribes to an H.264 bitstream topic and publishes decoded RGB images', 'create a MultiH264Bridge ROS2 node that initializes H.264 decoders for a configurable number of d360 sensors', 'review the ImageDecoder callback method that parses H.264 packets and decodes frames to ROS Image messages', 'refactor the ImageDecoder class to support a different video codec or output encoding format']
```

Usage

```
{'run_h264_bridge_node': 'run the ROS2 node that decodes H.264 encoded images from multiple d360 sensors', 'create_imagedecoder': 'create an ImageDecoder instance that subscribes to an H.264 bitstream topic and publishes decoded RGB images', 'create_multih264bridge': 'create a MultiH264Bridge ROS2 node that initializes H.264 decoders for a configurable number of d360 sensors', 'review_imagedecoder_callback': 'review the ImageDecoder callback method that parses H.264 packets and decodes frames to ROS Image messages', 'refactor_imagedecoder': 'refactor the ImageDecoder class to support a different video codec or output encoding format'}
```
